Lane is the primary operational object in Orchestrator; Worktree is the concrete filesystem/Git backing for a lane instance — lane identity persists after the live worktree is cleaned up/archived/removed

Lane/worktree lifecycle vocabulary must include these states: baseline, active, suspect, restoring, retained, cleanup_eligible, archived, removed, historical; 'historical' coexists with 'archived' or 'removed'; 'cleanup_eligible' ≠ already removed
archived, removed, deleted must remain semantically distinct
thread archived vs deleted are distinct
